channel.title: Farrelly Atkinson Limited - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Farrelly Atkinson Limited (road.cc)

item.title: “It’s ridiculous”: UCI’s controversial new handlebar rules see pro cyclist disqualified after 60km solo win, but team insists ‘illegal brake levers’ were bent in crash
item.description: Italian rider's team confident the bike was fully compliant at the start of the race and blame illegally narrow brake levers on crash damage

item.title: ‘Cycling only’ road closed to drivers since the pandemic faces pressure to reopen, but council hopeful “safe, accessible and attractive cycling routes” still possible
item.description: Council insists any change will look to deliver on "supporting safe, accessible and attractive walking and cycling routes"

item.title: Cervélo refreshes its Caledonia do-everything road bike, shedding 53g in weight and increasing tyre clearance to 36mm
item.description: Some small tweaks to Cervélo's all-road offering amount to a very slightly more feathery ride, the option to fit wider tyres and greater usability, particularly if you're a home mechanic

item.title: While Ireland debates mandatory hi-vis for cyclists, new figures show bike trips up 50% in two years in Dublin
item.description: Latest figures suggest more than half a million car journeys a day avoided by walking and cycling

item.title: Specialized is due a big redesign of its flagship gravel race bike: Here’s what a new Crux will need to be at the cutting edge
item.description: It's been a good few years since the big S last updated the Crux... will we see a revamped one in 2026? Here's what we're hoping will feature on the new bike (if we get one)

item.title: “We do not have a doping problem”: Tadej Pogačar’s agent opposes “stupid” plans to monitor riders’ power data, insisting cycling “now has credibility”
item.description: Alex Carera and others say the use of a ‘power data passport’ will “create only problems”, though the International Testing Agency has sought to assuage these concerns, suggesting the voluntary trial could become mandatory protocol over time

item.title: “I think this is talent at this point”: Possibly the filthiest drivetrain this bike shop has ever laid eyes on; Jeremy Vine called “nasty” for filming law-breaking drivers; Was Wout van Aert sabotaged?; Extreme tyre clearance + more on the live blog
item.description: Dan Alexander is back on live blog duty to take you through the midway point in the week with all the news, reaction, silliness and more from the world of cycling this Wednesday

item.title: 3T Racemax 2 Italia
item.description: Stiff, aero and very well specced – the 3T a great choice if you're a racer with deep pockets

item.title: “Knifepoint” bikejacking in broad daylight captured on CCTV outside busy coffee shop
item.description: The incident is the latest in a line of violent bike thefts to have recently occurred. Met Police took two hours to respond to the incident.

item.title: Anti-terrorism barriers set to prevent cyclists from using pedestrianised Oxford Street, under latest TfL plans
item.description: Campaigners had welcomed the pedestrianisation proposal but want to see better cycling route alternatives
